definitions.explanation: An armed exchange of gunfire between opposing parties, such as police and criminals, rival groups, or soldiers. Commonly seen in news reports and action films.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{銃撃戦|じゅうげきせん}になった。
examples.english: A shootout broke out with the police.

examples.japanese: {銃撃戦|じゅうげきせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧、⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: After a gun battle, the suspect was arrested.

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{終盤|しゅうばん}→終盤：13793_shuuban⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{派手|はで}→派手：03563_hade⟧な{銃撃戦|じゅうげきせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シーン→シーン：08914_shiin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a flashy shootout scene toward the end of the movie.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{銃撃|じゅうげき}→銃撃：27092_juugeki⟧ (shooting with a gun) + ⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧ (battle). Used for any exchange of gunfire involving two or more parties, whether in real events such as police operations and wars or in fictional action scenes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {銃撃戦|じゅうげきせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to turn into a shootout
- {銃撃戦|じゅうげきせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧: a gunfight breaks out
- ⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{銃撃戦|じゅうげきせん}: an intense gun battle
- {銃撃戦|じゅうげきせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧: after a gun battle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{銃撃|じゅうげき}→銃撃：27092_juugeki⟧: shooting (with a gun) — the act of shooting, not necessarily a two-sided exchange
- {発砲|はっぽう}: firing a gun — a single instance of firing, used in news reports
- ⟦{戦闘|せんとう}→戦闘：12639_sentou⟧: combat; battle — broader term covering any armed fighting
